title.en: AN ACT MAKING THE GOVERNOR OF THE PROVINCE OF PARAGUA A JUSTICE OF THE PEACE WITH JURISDICTION THROUGHOUT THE WHOLE OF THAT PROVINCE.
title.orig: AN ACT MAKING THE GOVERNOR OF THE PROVINCE OF PARAGUA A JUSTICE OF THE PEACE WITH JURISDICTION THROUGHOUT THE WHOLE OF THAT PROVINCE.
title.vi: Luật bổ nhiệm Tỉnh trưởng Paragua làm thẩm phán hòa giải có thẩm quyền trên toàn tỉnh
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแต่งตั้งผู้ว่าราชการจังหวัด Paragua เป็นผู้พิพากษาสันติภาพที่มีเขตอำนาจทั่วทั้งจังหวัด
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan Gubernur Provinsi Paragua sebagai hakim perdamaian dengan yurisdiksi di seluruh provinsi

text.en:
The governor of the Province of Paragua is hereby made ex officio justice of the peace with
authority to perform all the duties of a justice of the peace throughout the whole of the Province of Paragua.
His jurisdiction as justice of the peace shall he concurrent in every municipality and in every part of said
province with that of the proper justice of the peace of the municipality. The fees that would accrue to a
justice of the peace shall, in all cases where the provincial governor acts as justice of the peace, he covered
into the treasury of the province for the general purposes of the province.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall lake effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 6, 1905.
